warning: TEST-ONLY / NOMINAL / NO KERF / NOT FLIGHT PART
article_kind: actual root closed cell; measured GJ of the complete article, not effective material G

definitions.complete_article_mass_g: weighed assembled test D-box, including any attached birch-3 end bulkheads/clamp interfaces but excluding separate torque arm/guard unless deliberately attached
definitions.fixture_mass_g: mass of all test-fixture-only material included in complete_article_mass_g; record zero only if none is included
definitions.flight_representative_mass_g: complete_article_mass_g - fixture_mass_g; this is the only complete-article mass eligible for wing scaling
definitions.external_fixture_mass_g: optional record for removable torque arm/guard; never include in flight_representative_mass_g

mass_recording.scaling_basis: Scale only flight_representative_mass_g for this exact root closed-cell geometry; never scale fixture-only mass into the wing budget.
